newline: lf, bom: no
preamble:
  shebang: #!/usr/bin/env dotnet
  directive: package Reverb.Runtime 0.1.0
  header: v1
cells:
  [0] setup
      | using Reverb;
  [1] markdown id=intro
      | # LINQ basics
      | Query syntax and method syntax side by side.
  [2] code id=numbers
      | int[] numbers = [5, 3, 8, 1, 9, 2, 7];
  [3] code id=query
      | var evens = from n in numbers
      |             where n % 2 == 0
      |             orderby n
      |             select n;
  [4] code id=method
      | var odds = numbers.Where(n => n % 2 == 1).Order().ToArray();
  [5] code id=groups
      | var groups = numbers
      |     .GroupBy(n => n % 3)
      |     .Select(g => (Remainder: g.Key, Count: g.Count()))
      |     .OrderBy(t => t.Remainder)
      |     .ToList();
  [6] code id=show
      | Console.WriteLine(string.Join(",", evens));
      | Console.WriteLine(string.Join(",", odds));
      | groups.Dump("by remainder");
diagnostics: none
